conviction_note: The release is real but lands Tue 10 Nov before the open, after the Mon 9 Nov board, so the scored window is close(9 Nov) to close(10 Nov) (amc). Nothing from Q3 is pre-released, and the FY26 EBITDA guide of EUR 330-350m (first given 15 Sep) implies H2 of 160-180m against a Q2 run-rate of about 99m a quarter, so a top-end or raised guide is plausible. The Tosano deal adds framing for 2027. Against that, the stock is +33.6% over 20 days and +5.4% on 6 Nov, the guide was set with July-August already known, and the doubled tomato campaign points to a working-capital build at 30 Sep. So the move is sized large (7%) and the sign only slightly positive (p_up 54). The findings sum to +1.2 and the scaled number is +0.56. The gap is the run-up and the guide's mid-September date, which pull p_up toward 50 without making any single finding smaller.

session_check: amc. The 2026 financial calendar approved on 11 Nov 2025 puts the board meeting approving the 30 Sep 2026 interim on Monday 9 November 2026 (https://www.emarketstorage.com/sites/default/files/comunicati/2025-11/20251111_174149.pdf). The only calendar change since then (28 Jan 2026, https://www.emarketstorage.com/sites/default/files/comunicati/2026-01/20260128_176823.pdf) moved only the FY date and says results publish the day after the board. Every 2026 release went out at 08:04-08:05 CET on the morning after the board: FY 31 Mar, Q1 14 May (board calendared 13 May), H1 15 Sep (board 14 Sep). The Tosano release says the 30 Sep results call is on 10 November 2026 at 11:00 CET (https://www.emarketstorage.com/sites/default/files/comunicati/2026-11/20261105_191389.pdf). So the print is expected about 08:05 CET Tue 10 Nov and the reaction window is close(9 Nov) to close(10 Nov). The baseline's bmo 6 Nov to 9 Nov window contains no release.

It names no position for NewPrinces, so short_ratio_pct 0.0 is the 0.5% truncation floor and not a measurement; anchor_covered is false. Building or covering is unknown. There is no positioning anchor, so the priced lean (-1.68) is essentially the 20-day run-up of +33.6%.

findings.finding: The FY26 EBITDA guide of EUR 330-350m implies H2 EBITDA of 160-180m, while Q2 2026 alone produced about EUR 98.9m (H1 170.1m less Q1's 4.76% margin on 1,496.6m, about 71.2m). At the Q2 run-rate, H2 is about 198m and FY about 368m, above the top of the guide, so 9M is likely to track at or above the top end and a raise or 'upper end' language is plausible.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q1 2026 release raised the retail EBITDA outlook ('in anticipo rispetto alle aspettative iniziali'): +4.1% on the day. The H1 release introduced the group guide: +1.5% on the day and +8.9% the next. FY25 'record results': +8.45%, then -20% and -7.5% over the next two sessions with no news (the company filed a no-inside-information statement on 2 Apr).
findings.original_quote: Guidance EBITDA FY 2026 stimata tra Euro 330 e 350 milioni. ... EBITDA margin ... in netto miglioramento rispetto a quanto registrato nel corso del primo trimestre 2026 (4,76% al 31 marzo 2026). [Translation: FY2026 EBITDA guidance estimated at EUR 330-350m; margin sharply improved on Q1 2026's 4.76%.]
findings.why_not_priced: The quarter split is not reported; it has to be derived from the Q1 margin footnote, and only two analysts cover the name. If the market already priced a raise, Intesa would be on EV/EBITDA computed above the guide. It cites 3.5x on 2026, which at about EUR 1bn market cap plus net debt is consistent with roughly the guide. But the guide was set on 15 Sep with July-August already visible to management, so the H2 deceleration may be known and deliberate, and the stock has risen 33.6% in 20 days, partly on this expectation. Sized small for both reasons.
findings.independence: Princes Group plc (the listed food subsidiary) said on 15 Sep that price increases effective 1 July land in Q3 and Q4 and that it trades in line with FY26 expectations: https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/princes-group-plc--prn/interim-results-for-the-six-months-ended-30-june/9771573

findings.finding: The GS-Tosano agreement (5 Nov, 15:29 CET) adds about EUR 40m a year of EBITDA from the first phase, about 12% of the FY26 guide midpoint. Management promised further detail on its economic and financial effects on the 10 Nov 11:00 CET results call, which could become a first 2027 frame.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On the deal itself the stock was +1.2% on 5 Nov (intraday release) and +5.4% on 6 Nov. When the Carrefour Italia acquisition was announced in July 2025 it fell 8.4% the next day.
findings.original_quote: L'Operazione sarà illustrata e discussa dal management di NewPrinces nell'ambito della conference call dedicata alla presentazione dei risultati economico-finanziari consolidati del Gruppo al 30 settembre 2026, prevista per il 10 novembre 2026 alle ore 11:00 CET. Nel corso della call, il management fornirà ulteriori dettagli in merito al razionale strategico dell'Operazione e ai relativi effetti economici e finanziari attesi. [Translation: the deal will be discussed on the 30 Sep results call on 10 Nov at 11:00 CET, where management will give further detail on its expected economic and financial effects.]
findings.why_not_priced: The headline is mostly priced: two up sessions totalling about +6.7% after publication. What is not out is the accounting treatment (revenue down about EUR 500m, possible held-for-sale or impairment on the stores), the AGCM timing and any 2027 framing. These can cut either way, hence the wide band.
findings.independence: Alliance News via MarketScreener notes that the EUR 453m 'non rappresenta un corrispettivo integralmente garantito' (is not a fully guaranteed consideration) and that the deal is conditional on AGCM: https://it.marketscreener.com/notizie/newprinces-sigla-deal-con-tosano-valore-potenziale-di-eur453-milioni-ce785fdcd180fe21

findings.finding: Princes Group plc (the food subsidiary, reporting the same day) said its 1 July price increases are realised in Q3-Q4 and that the timing lag has had no significant margin impact.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Princes' Q1 and H1 updates were released on the same mornings as NewPrinces' (14 May, 15 Sep). NewPrinces moved +4.1% and +1.5% on those days, so the subsidiary line is not separable.
findings.why_not_priced: It lands inside what the group already guided, so it is near zero. It stays on file because it is a direct counterparty statement that the Q3 margin should not show the cost lag.
findings.independence: The NewPrinces H1 release says the same: falling cost of sales and stable volumes: https://www.emarketstorage.com/sites/default/files/comunicati/2026-09/20260915_189203.pdf

findings.finding: The 2026 tomato campaign was expected at about 220,000 t, more than double the roughly 110,000 t of 2025, with the whole production already sold. Volume growth over the next 12 months is mostly a 2027 revenue contributor.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No separable history: first disclosed in the H1 release.
findings.original_quote: La chiusura è prevista entro la fine di settembre, con una produzione attesa di circa 220.000 tonnellate, più che doppia rispetto alle poco meno di 110.000 tonnellate realizzate nella campagna precedente. L'intera produzione prevista risulta già venduta. [Translation: closing expected by end-September, with expected production of about 220,000 t, more than double the just under 110,000 t of the prior campaign. The whole expected output is already sold.]
findings.why_not_priced: Public since 15 Sep and aimed at 2027. It only matters if the call turns it into a 2027 number, so it stays small.

findings.finding: The H1 release flags inflation in freight and energy and Middle East and Hormuz risk to energy and raw-material costs in H2: a cost headwind to Q3 margins.
findings.original_quote: Nonostante gli impatti inflattivi su noli ed energia a livello di Gruppo, la riduzione dei prezzi di vendita riflette in misura significativa il calo a doppia cifra dei costi di alcune delle principali materie prime [Translation: despite inflationary impacts on freight and energy at group level, the cut in selling prices largely reflects double-digit falls in some key raw-material costs.]
findings.why_not_priced: This is a macro-to-company transmission. The company says there is no quantifiable direct impact, and Princes says its pricing flexibility absorbed the lag. Small for that reason.
findings.independence: Princes Group plc H1 2026 outlook mentions ongoing inflationary pressures managed without significant margin impact: https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/princes-group-plc--prn/interim-results-for-the-six-months-ended-30-june/9771573

findings.finding: ISTAT: Italian large-scale retail sales in July 2026 were +1.6% in value and +0.6% in volume YoY, hypermarkets +1.6% in value and -0.1% in volume. The market GS (retail, 54% of revenue) sells into was flat in volume, so this is no tailwind or headwind for the retail line.
findings.original_quote: Rispetto a luglio 2025, le vendite al dettaglio sono in aumento per la grande distribuzione (+1,6% in valore e +0,6% in volume) [Translation: compared with July 2025, retail sales rose for large-scale retail, +1.6% in value and +0.6% in volume.]
findings.why_not_priced: A broad public series that implies nothing company-specific, so it is sized at zero.

findings.finding: Doubling the tomato campaign to about 220k t in August-September implies a larger seasonal inventory and working-capital build at 30 Sep, so 9M PFN and free cash flow may read weaker than the H1 trend (PFN -67.3m at 30 Jun after -60.6m at 31 Mar).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 9M 2025 release led with cash ('ottima generazione di cassa', FCF conversion 104%) and the stock fell 1.8% on the day.
findings.original_quote: PFN consolidata al 30 giugno 2026 pari Euro -67,3 milioni ... la campagna del pomodoro 2026 è ancora in corso ... produzione attesa di circa 220.000 tonnellate [Translation: consolidated PFN at 30 Jun 2026 EUR -67.3m ... the 2026 tomato campaign is still under way ... expected output about 220,000 t.]
findings.why_not_priced: An inference from two disclosed facts that the company has not quantified. Retail's negative working capital may offset it. Small and negative.

Intesa says two of five manufacturing M&A targets could close in 2026; no dated event inside the window.

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly positive (guide arithmetic, Tosano framing), against a priced lean of -1.68 that is just the +33.6% 20-day and +43.9% 60-day run-up. Most of the visible good news (Intesa target 28, Tosano) is in that run-up, so p_up sits only slightly above 50.
language_note: The Italian filings carried the 2026 calendar with the Monday 9 Nov board date and the publication-next-day convention ('la pubblicazione dei risultati FY 2025 avverrà in data 31 marzo 2026'). The vendor's 9 Nov bmo date is wrong without them.

The Q1 EBITDA margin footnote (4.76%), which makes the Q2 run-rate (about 99m) derivable, and the tomato campaign figure of 220k t, came from the Italian H1 release. English wire coverage carried only the guide.

The Italian Tosano release and the Teleborsa/MarketScreener Italian coverage gave the 10 Nov 11:00 CET call date, the AGCM condition and the 'non integralmente garantito' caveat. No English-language coverage of the deal was found.
The ISTAT large-retail series by format (hypermarkets -0.1% in volume) is Italian-only.
lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' (guidance changes median 9% against 2.3%) and 'too small about the move': abs_move_pct raised from 6.0 to 7.0. The numbers are new and a guide move is plausible on a 2-analyst, $2m/day name.
'Cash can outweigh a raised guide': added a working-capital finding (-0.4) on the doubled tomato campaign, which brings the sum from 1.6 to 1.2.
'Positioning is the thing to beat' and 'a verified fact is not a predicted reaction' (FY25 +8.45% then -20%): p_up from 55 to 54. The finding sizes are unchanged.
'The session is the most load-bearing field' and 'open with the verdict': session_check opens with amc and the issuer timestamps.
